pages.html:
ADV MIDICARE LIMITED | Virtual Patient Simulation System

ADV MEDICARE LIMITED

A Virtual Patient Simulation System (Digital Twin) driven by cutting-edge AI, dedicated to solving the clinical pain points of low immunotherapy response rates and long waiting times for Hepatocellular Carcinoma (HCC).

Pioneering the Future of Precision Oncology

ADV MEDICARE LIMITED is an innovative medical technology enterprise dedicated to revolutionizing the treatment landscape for complex diseases, with a primary focus on Hepatocellular Carcinoma (HCC). We bridge the gap between advanced artificial intelligence and real-world clinical applications.

By seamlessly integrating multi-omics data, cutting-edge AI algorithms, and comprehensive medical imaging, we are building highly accurate "Digital Twin" models for patients. Our proprietary systems empower clinicians to predict treatment outcomes, optimize therapeutic regimens, and significantly reduce the critical time patients spend waiting for effective care.

Rooted in rigorous scientific research and validated by continuous clinical testing, ADV MIDICARE is committed to ensuring that every patient receives the right treatment at the right time.

Core Governance & Founders

Combining top-tier scientific expertise with profound technological and clinical backgrounds.

MAK CHUNG YIN

PHILIP | Co-founder & Director

Core R&D team member, leading the underlying architecture and clinical application deployment of the Virtual Patient Simulation System (Digital Twin).

Tsui Fong Wai

Adam | Co-founder & Director

Core R&D team member, driving the seamless integration of medical AI technology with hospital Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems and multidimensional data analysis.

Virtual Patient Simulation System

One-click import of multidimensional clinical data, generating core insights through deep AI analysis.

Disease & Outcome Prediction

Extracts deep features via AI models to generate MDT treatment reports and accurately predict immunotherapy response rates, avoiding ineffective treatments.

Similar Patient Search

Rapidly matches new patients with historical similar cases in real-world databases, intuitively displaying past treatment regimens and clinical outcomes.

Progression Forecasting

Integrates complex factors such as relapse, survival rates, and comorbidities to provide personalized disease progression and prognosis predictions.

Join Our Team

We are looking for passionate individuals to build the next generation of healthcare technology with us.

posts.title: Strengthening Global Collaboration in Medical Innovation: Exchange with Chiang Mai University at Geneva Inventions Expo
posts.html:
During the 50th International Exhibition of Inventions Geneva, our team had the pleasure of engaging in a meaningful exchange with representatives from the Faculty of Nursing at Chiang Mai University, Thailand. The discussions centered around the application of virtual reality (VR) in medical education, with both sides presenting forward-thinking solutions to shape the future of healthcare training.

Chiang Mai University showcased their project “Good Nurse in We are Nursing (VR Technology),” which focuses on immersive VR experiences for nursing students to enhance clinical decision-making in a safe, simulated environment.

In parallel, we proudly presented our Virtual Patient Simulation System, We are reshaping healthcare with AI. Our virtual patient platform helps doctors make smarter decisions by simulating real-world cases and predicting outcomes. Whether it’s early detection, personalized treatment, or better recovery plans, we provide actionable insights that save time, reduce costs, and improve patient care. Cloud-based and easy to use, our solution empowers hospitals, clinics, and insurers to deliver more precise, data-driven care—anytime, anywhere.

The two teams exchanged insights on simulation design, educational outcomes, and potential cooperation models. The shared vision of advancing intelligent medical education laid the groundwork for possible future collaboration.

This exchange not only highlighted the innovation showcased at Geneva but also exemplified the potential for international cooperation in health tech development.

Photo Highlights from the Exchange

We look forward to exploring future opportunities to work alongside Chiang Mai University and other global partners to drive the future of intelligent healthcare training.

posts.title: A Moment of Pride: Our “Virtual Patient Simulation System” Selected for the Geneva International Exhibition of Inventions
posts.excerpt: We are thrilled to announce that ou…
posts.html:
We are thrilled to announce that our independently developed patented invention, the “Virtual Patient Simulation System,” has been successfully shortlisted for the 50th Geneva International Exhibition of Inventions. It will be showcased as part of the delegation from The Hong Kong Polytechnic University. This achievement is a testament to our team’s innovative capabilities and marks a significant milestone for our company in the field of medical technology.

About the “Virtual Patient Simulation System”

The “Virtual Patient Simulation System” is an innovative technology platform that utilizes advanced algorithms and artificial intelligence, combined with genomic or phenotypic data, to predict treatment outcomes such as cancer therapy responses and relapse scenarios. By simulating realistic medical scenarios, the system enables healthcare professionals to efficiently enhance their clinical training and diagnostic decision-making.

Key advantages of the system include:

  • Personalized Case Simulations: Tailored virtual cases for different patients and disease scenarios.
  • Data-Driven Decision Support: Provides probability predictions and decision curve visualizations to help doctors quickly evaluate the feasibility of treatment plans.
  • High Flexibility and Scalability: Compatible with high-end workstations and cloud platforms, meeting the needs of various healthcare environments.
  • Enhanced Medical Efficiency: Reduces trial-and-error processes, optimizes resource allocation, and improves overall treatment effectiveness.

Through these capabilities, the “Virtual Patient Simulation System” aims to revolutionize personalized medicine, empowering doctors to make more informed clinical decisions and delivering better patient care and more efficient healthcare management.

About the Geneva International Exhibition of Inventions

The Geneva International Exhibition of Inventions is one of the most influential invention fairs in the world. Since its inception in 1973, it has attracted leading innovators from dozens of countries globally. Every year, the exhibition showcases hundreds of groundbreaking innovations across various fields, providing a vital platform for demonstrating research achievements and exploring partnership opportunities.

Stepping onto the Global Stage

Being shortlisted for this prestigious event is not only an acknowledgment of the value of the “Virtual Patient Simulation System” but also a reflection of our commitment to driving innovation in medical technology. We look forward to sharing experiences, exploring collaborations, and bringing our technology to a broader market by participating in this premier global invention exhibition.

Gratitude and Outlook

We extend our heartfelt gratitude to The Hong Kong Polytechnic University for their unwavering support and to all the team members who contributed to the development of the “Virtual Patient Simulation System.” Moving forward, we will continue to uphold our philosophy of “technological innovation” and deliver more high-quality solutions to the global medical community.

Stay tuned to our website and social media channels for more updates on our participation and the latest developments regarding the “Virtual Patient Simulation System.” Let us look forward to this invention shining on the stage of the Geneva International Exhibition of Inventions!

posts.title: Technical Exchange: Meeting with Professor Lan Tian’s Team at Guangzhou Pharmaceutical University and the Director of the Imaging Department at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center
posts.excerpt: In October 2024, our team visited G…
posts.html:
In October 2024, our team visited Guangzhou Pharmaceutical University to engage in an in-depth discussion with Professor Lan Tian’s team and the Director of the Imaging Department at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center. The meeting focused on personalized liver cancer treatment and deep learning technologies, providing us with new insights and inspiration for applying artificial intelligence in the field of liver cancer diagnosis and treatment.

Our Technical Highlights

  • Development of Personalized Liver Cancer Treatment Plans:
    Our deep learning service integrates imaging, pathology, and genomic data to offer comprehensive disease assessments and precise treatment recommendations for patients. Utilizing advanced deep learning models, the system can automatically analyze liver images, recommend targeted therapies, predict treatment efficacy, and provide prognostic evaluations.
  • Assisting Physicians in Treatment Planning:
    The system supports a similar patient search function, providing physicians with reference cases to help optimize treatment plans. It also enables real-time monitoring of treatment responses to ensure that patients receive the most appropriate therapy.
  • Progress in Clinical Validation:
    Currently, our solution is undergoing multi-center clinical validation to ensure its feasibility and safety in real-world clinical settings

Through this technical exchange, we have further strengthened our connections with experts in academia and the clinical field, laying a solid foundation for advancing precision medicine in liver cancer. We look forward to collaborating with more partners to jointly usher in a new chapter of integrating artificial intelligence with healthcare.

posts.title: Showcasing Our AI-Powered Liver Cancer Treatment Solution at BIOHK 2024
posts.html:
In September 2024, we proudly participated in BIOHK 2024 as a startup exhibitor. This prestigious event brought together the brightest minds and leading companies in biotechnology and life sciences, offering an exceptional platform to showcase innovative technologies and explore the future of the industry.

About BIOHK 2024

BIOHK 2024 is a global gathering dedicated to presenting cutting-edge technologies, integrating stakeholders, and accelerating the commercialization, translation, and industrialization of groundbreaking research. The event attracted top-tier companies, research institutions, and investors from around the world, fostering collaborations and advancing industry growth.

Our Featured Innovation

At BIOHK 2024, we showcased our AI-powered deep learning service for personalized liver cancer treatment planning, highlighting its transformative potential in clinical practice:

  • Comprehensive Data Integration: Our system combines imaging, pathology, and genomic data to deliver precise disease assessments and tailored treatment recommendations.
  • Smart Diagnostic Assistance: Utilizing advanced deep learning models, it automates liver image analysis and integrates genomic insights to provide personalized recommendations for targeted therapies, efficacy predictions, and prognosis assessments.
  • Similar Patient Search: The system offers a tool for physicians to explore similar cases, aiding in the development of optimized treatment strategies.
  • Validated through Clinical Trials: The solution is currently undergoing multicenter clinical trials to ensure its safety and feasibility in real-world clinical applications.

Our technology not only enhances the accuracy of early liver cancer detection but also enables real-time monitoring of treatment responses, empowering physicians to provide the most suitable treatment plans for their patients. This represents a significant step forward in personalized and precision medicine.

Engagement with Industry Leaders

We were honored to take part in a photo opportunity with Professor Yu Changhai, Chairman of the Hong Kong Biotechnology Organization, during the event. As a prominent leader in the biotechnology field, Professor Yu’s presence underscored the event’s significance and further highlighted the importance of fostering innovation in the industry.

Participation in BIOHK 2024 was a milestone for our company, offering us a platform to demonstrate our cutting-edge technology and gain recognition on the global stage. This experience inspires us to continue innovating and advancing personalized and precision medicine.

Looking ahead, we remain committed to collaboration and innovation, working with industry peers to drive the clinical application and industrialization of breakthrough technologies in biotechnology and life sciences.

posts.title: Towards Clinical Adoption: Successful Deployment of Our Product at the Imaging Department of CUHK (Shenzhen) Affiliated Hospital
posts.excerpt: We are thrilled to announce that as…
posts.html:
We are thrilled to announce that as of December 2024, our flagship product has been successfully deployed at the Imaging Department of the Chinese University of Hong Kong (Shenzhen) Affiliated Hospital and is currently undergoing clinical evaluation. This marks a significant milestone in advancing the clinical application of our AI-powered solution for personalized liver cancer treatment.

About the Deployment

  • Empowering Healthcare with Innovative Technology:
    Our system integrates imaging, pathology, and genomic data to deliver comprehensive disease assessments and precise treatment recommendations for liver cancer patients. Leveraging advanced deep learning models, it automates liver imaging analysis and combines genomic insights to assist doctors in recommending targeted therapies, predicting outcomes, and evaluating prognoses.
  • Intelligent Decision Support:
    The system also offers a similar patient search function, enabling physicians to reference comparable cases and refine personalized treatment plans further.
  • On the Path to Clinical Validation:
    Currently, the product is being thoroughly evaluated in a real clinical setting at the Imaging Department of CUHK (Shenzhen) Affiliated Hospital, where its performance and feasibility are being rigorously assessed.

Looking Ahead

This deployment represents a critical step in translating cutting-edge technology into clinical practice, paving the way for broader adoption across more healthcare institutions. As the system undergoes continuous optimization and evaluation, we are confident it will bring significant value to the field of liver cancer precision treatment.

We firmly believe in the transformative power of technology in healthcare. This collaboration is not only a strong testament to the technical strength of our product but also an essential milestone on the journey toward clinical adoption. Moving forward, we remain committed to delivering innovative, efficient, and precise solutions for liver cancer patients and the medical community at large.

posts.title: Team Member KONG Luoyi Wins Bronze at The Ascend AI Innovation Competition 2023, Founder Lawrence Chan Honored with Huawei ITC Ecosystem Contribution Award
posts.excerpt: We are thrilled to announce that Te…
posts.html:
We are thrilled to announce that Team Member Luoyi was awarded the Bronze Award at the The Ascend AI Innovation Competition 2023, held in December. At the same time, our Founder Lawrence received the prestigious Huawei ITC Ecosystem Contribution Award in recognition of outstanding contributions to the industry’s ecosystem. These dual achievements highlight our team’s dedication to technological innovation and industry impact.

Team Member Luoyi’s Outstanding Achievement

The Ascend AI Innovation Competition is a globally recognized event that attracts top AI practitioners and research teams from around the world. This year’s competition focused on the theme of “AI-Driven Sustainable Solutions”. A excelled in the competition with her project, “Interpretability Scheme of Liver Disease Classification for Computer-Aided Diagnostic System”, emerging as one of the top winners from over 500 entries.

The project introduces an innovative interpretability framework for liver disease classification within AI-powered diagnostic systems. By enhancing transparency and reliability, this solution not only improves diagnostic accuracy and efficiency but also significantly advances the clinical applicability of AI in healthcare, contributing to the modernization of medical technology.

Founder Lawrence’s Industry Leadership

Simultaneously, our Founder Lawrence was honored with the Huawei ITC Ecosystem Contribution Award for extraordinary efforts in building a collaborative and thriving ITC ecosystem. Lawrence’s commitment to fostering industry partnerships and integrating technological resources has established multiple benchmark projects, greatly benefiting the development of a healthy and sustainable industry ecosystem.

These prestigious recognitions are a testament to the exceptional contributions of Luoyi and Lawrence, as well as the strength of our entire team. Moving forward, we remain committed to driving innovation and creating value for our clients, partners, and the broader community.
